label: Airtable
description: Airtable cloud database: search, fetch, delete, and comment on records, plus base schema lookup.
notes: Skipped airtable.createRecord: id already live in catalog/productivity.json and no strictly-richer template version is possible — the API requires 'fields' as a true JSON object, which templating cannot emit (note: the live node uses {{json config.fields}} for that object, the pattern rule 2 forbids; flagging for review). Update/Clean Record share the same typed-object body and schema-transform logic (createNewFields) → needsPieceRuntime. findRecord: dropped the optional 'view' filter config — an empty view query param is not reliably tolerated, and templates cannot conditionally omit params; the FIND() formula is percent-encoded literally in the URL with only user values urlencoded (a double quote in the search value will break the formula, same limitation as the source piece). addComment: dropped optional parentCommentId (threaded replies) — empty string would be rejected. All AP dynamic dropdowns (base, table, record, field) became plain text config fields with ID hints.
